round: Finanzas, round 1: four different ideas, one picture each
style: A single 3D character render in the style of a premium designer vinyl toy: glossy, smooth, soft studio lighting, subtle reflections, rich small details. The character is a friendly ghost office worker for an app called Ghostaff: a white sheet ghost with no legs, a rounded silhouette with a wavy hem, two small nub hands made from the sheet, big shiny dark eyes and a small mouth. Full body, three-quarter front view, centred, floating slightly above a soft shadow, on a plain very light warm grey background. No text, no logos, no other characters. Its department colour is a deep fresh green, used only on its outfit and props, never on the body.

ideas.title: Vinyl accountant
ideas.prompt: the finance ghost as a neat modern accountant: round thin-framed glasses, a green tie, holding a small chunky calculator with green display. Calm, precise, kind.

ideas.title: Old-school bookkeeper
ideas.prompt: the finance ghost as a 1920s bookkeeper: a translucent green eyeshade visor, green sleeve garters on its nub arms, a pencil tucked on its side, hugging a thick leather ledger with gold-edged pages and a few receipts sticking out. Taller than wide, a little nerdy and proud.

ideas.title: Vault keeper
ideas.prompt: the finance ghost as the keeper of the company's money: wider than tall and sturdy, a green waistcoat with a big ring of brass keys hanging from it, sitting on a small stack of gold coins next to a tiny round vault door. Protective and cosy.

ideas.title: Fintech analyst
ideas.prompt: the finance ghost as a sleek modern fintech analyst: a slim green vest, a tiny wireless earpiece, holding a glowing tablet showing a simple rising green bar chart, small floating receipts orbiting around it like satellites. Sharp, optimistic, a bit futuristic.
